title: Fix pinned_step for limit-cycle pinning and add driver node search
body:
## Summary
- Fix bug in `pinned_step()` where pinned variables were copied from `initial` instead of written from `pinned_binstate`, breaking limit-cycle pinning control (pcstg fragmented into disconnected snapshots, `fraction_pinned_configurations` returned 0)
- Add `pinning_control_driver_nodes()` for minimum-size driver set search with `ceil(log2(N_attractors))` lower bound and a cheap necessary-condition pre-filter (`_signatures_distinguish_attractors`)
- Rename `attsource`/`attsink` → `src_pin`/`dst_pin` in pcstg construction for clarity
- Add 18 tests covering `pinned_step` semantics, pcstg WCC invariants, fraction_pinned_configurations, driver node search, and the pre-filter

## Test plan
- [x] 18 new tests in `test_pinning_control.py` all pass
- [x] Full test suite (79 tests) passes on Python 3.13
